description: This file manages process and error pipe handling within the 'angel' module, including creating, freeing, and manipulating error pipes, as well as spawning new processes with specific resource limits and user privileges.

classes.name: liErrorPipe
classes.description: Represents an error pipe used for inter-process communication, including callbacks and file descriptors.

classes.name: liProc
classes.description: Represents a spawned process with associated resources, including its PID, application name, and error pipe.

methods.name: void read_pipe(liServer * srv,liErrorPipe * epipe,gboolean flush)
methods.description: Reads data from the error pipe into a buffer, handling various error conditions and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: void error_pipe_cb(liEventBase * watcher,int events)
methods.description: Callback invoked when the error pipe has data to read, triggering buffer processing.

methods.name: liErrorPipe * li_error_pipe_new(liServer * srv,liErrorPipeCB cb,gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Creates a new error pipe with associated callback and context.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_free(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an error pipe, including closing file descriptors and clearing event watchers.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_activate(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Activates the error pipe to start out-fd handling.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_use(liErrorPipe * epipe,int dest_fd)
methods.description: Uses the error pipe by duplicating its out-fd to a specified destination fd.

methods.name: void li_error_pipe_flush(liErrorPipe * epipe)
methods.description: Flushes any remaining data from the error pipe.

methods.name: liProc * li_proc_new(liServer * srv,gchar ** args,gchar ** env,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gchar * username,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile,liProcSetupCB cb,gpointer ctx)
methods.description: Spawns a new process with specified arguments, environment, resource limits, and user privileges, setting up error pipe communication.

methods.name: void li_proc_free(liProc * proc)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a process object.

ctags.name: li_proc_new
ctags.pattern: /^liProc* li_proc_new(liServer *srv, gchar **args, gchar **env, uid_t uid, gid_t gid, gchar *usern/
ctags.signature: (liServer * srv,gchar ** args,gchar ** env,uid_t uid,gid_t gid,gchar * username,gint64 rlim_core,gint64 rlim_nofile,liProcSetupCB cb,gpointer ctx)
